sections.brief: Tepeyac and Tonantzin: Sahagún's 1576 complaint (Book 11 appendix); Tonantzin as title ('our revered mother'); the 1531 story and its paper trail (Zumárraga silent; Montúfar-Bustamante 8 Sept 1556; Sánchez 1648; Laso de la Vega 1649 Nican Mopohua; Laso vs Valeriano authorship); Poole 1995, Schulenburg 1996, Codex Escalada; Juan Diego beatified 1990, canonized 31 July 2002; European (Rev 12) vs Nahua readings of the image. Figures: time (documents); compare (two readings)

Pachamama and the Virgins of Candelaria, Copacabana (Tito Yupanqui c.1576) and the Potosí mountain-Virgin (1720); Rome Oct 2019: figures thrown in the Tiber by lay critics (Tschugguel), Francis's apology 25 Oct; Oshún/Yemayá with the Virgins of El Cobre and Regla, Iemanjá in Brazil, syncretism under slavery and the scholarly debate; Brigid (debated); Black Madonnas graded. Figures: compare (mothers, Virgins, who pressed, what survives)

Isis lactans vs Maria lactans (Higgins: no proven continuity); Ephesus 431 and the Artemis claim graded; Queen of Heaven (Apuleius XI; Ephrem; Regina Caeli) and Stella Maris (stilla/stella); Navigium Isidis; Gregory to Mellitus 601; Sophia/Wisdom and Bulgakov 1935; Mary Magdalene (Gregory 591, 1969, 2016); counter-record: Marian dogmas 431/1854/1950, LG 66 limit, Mater populi fidelis 4 Nov 2025; labelled interpretation ('approved mother') with counter-readings. Figures: compare (claim/record/grade)
